CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.taste_rating_advance_v2(p_action text, p_round_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_work_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, p_score integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_language text DEFAULT 'en'::text, p_goal integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select taste_private.advance_round_v2(p_action,p_round_id,p_work_id,p_score,p_language,p_goal);
$function$
